Use case: ui-mockup. Create one polished high fidelity desktop game interface concept for Dicebound, a Russian virtual tabletop. Landscape 16:9, crisp legible Russian text, straight-on UI screenshot without physical monitor. Independent visual direction: cartographer's atlas, warm ivory paper workspace, deep forest green navigation, copper accents, elegant serif headings paired with clean sans-serif controls. Restrained fine rules, generous spacing, subtle paper grain; professional usable software, not ornate fantasy framing. All controls substantial and aligned, no overlapping labels. No invented quest system, currency, automated attacks, voice chat, cloud campaign list, or spells engine. This is a design proposal not a screenshot of existing software. SCREEN 1: Entry lobby. Large sophisticated Dicebound wordmark and little geometric d20 emblem top left. A beautiful restrained overhead ink atlas illustration of ruined abbey and dice occupies left 44%, abstract decorative only. Right workspace has heading "Соберите свою историю", global nickname field "Ваше имя" value "Виктор". Below two side by side distinct cards, clear roles. Card "Я мастер": primary button "Создать онлайн-сессию", secondary "Подготовить без игроков", small explanatory copy "Подготовьте карту и сохраните сессию в файл". Card "Я игрок": field "Код сессии" with example "ABC123", primary button "Войти по коду". Small "Настройки" and "Закрыть игру" footer controls. Small top right caption "КОНЦЕПТ 01 / ВХОД". Layout fresh editorial asymmetry, no central stack of identical buttons. No recent campaigns or user account.
